summary: Deploy v1.3.0 added a cache that stores large byte arrays per request and raises 503 when full, causing memory exhaustion and high 5xx rate. Rolling back to v1.0.0 removes the faulty cache.
next_steps: Add size limit to cache and evict old entries
Deploy monitoring for cache size and memory usage
Run load test to verify fix

proposed_actions.reason: Cache implementation introduced unbounded memory growth causing 5xx
